articles.title: Crusoe Raises Over $3 Billion in Funding at $30 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer doing business with OpenAI, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc., has raised over $3 billion in a funding round that values the startup at roughly $30 billion, according to people familiar with the situation.
articles.author: Rebecca Torrence, Dina Bass and Edward Ludlow

articles.title: Broadcom Forecasts Boom in AI Chip Sales
articles.summary: Broadcom predicted a surge in artificial intelligence chip sales over the next two years, helping renew optimism that it can challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the lucrative market. The company also is on track to top earnings of $30 a share in fiscal 2028, outpacing Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Beyond the Model: The Unlikely Architecture of the AI Winners
articles.summary: There is no single "winner" of the AI space. While labs like OpenAI and Anthropic fight over the model layer, the real, durable victory is happening in the plumbing. Compute (NVIDIA), inference (vLLM), and economic routing (Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter) are proving far more valuable and stable than the AI models themselves, positioning infrastructure as the true king of the AI boom.Read All
articles.author: Olaoluwa Afolabi

articles.title: Tencent-Backed Enflame’s IPO Draws 4,073 Times Retail Demand
articles.summary: The initial public offering of Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., a company backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., drew strong demand from retail investors, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.
articles.author: Bloomberg News

articles.title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
articles.summary: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.
articles.author: Samantha Kelly

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Tops Profit Outlook on AI Security Demand
articles.summary: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.

articles.title: Polymarket Valuation Hits $21B, Led By Trump Jr.'s 1789
articles.summary: Bloomberg's Todd Gillespie joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Venture capital firm 1789 Capital is leading a new funding round for Polymarket that will give the prediction-markets platform a $21 billion post-money valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: JPMorgan’s Aliaga Says Market Can Absorb ‘Attractive’ Tech Debt
articles.summary: JPMorgan Asset Management’s Stephanie Aliaga said that the bond market can absorb the growing supply of hyperscaler debt, as rising artificial intelligence demand reassures investors that the companies can pay their obligations.
articles.author: Ed Ludlow

articles.title: AI Boom Fuels a New Tech Debt Binge
articles.summary: Big Tech is increasingly turning to debt to finance the massive buildout of AI infrastructure. JPMorgan Asset Management's global market strategist Stephanie Aliaga explains why hyperscaler bond issuance is poised to keep growing, how the market is absorbing the new supply, and why stronger visibility into AI returns could help sustain the spending boom. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
